title: FUTO Swipe – A new swipe typing model
summary: FUTO Swipe is a new open-source swipe typing model developed by FUTO, offering a privacy-focused alternative to mainstream keyboard swipe input systems. The project garnered significant attention on Hacker News with 553 points and 185 comments, indicating strong community interest in open-source input method solutions.
problem_solved: Provides a privacy-respecting, open-source alternative to proprietary swipe typing solutions from big tech companies that typically require cloud processing of user keystrokes.
why_valuable: It offers users and developers an open, transparent swipe typing solution that can run entirely on-device, protecting user privacy while maintaining typing efficiency.
